The graveyard is introduced in the tutorial. An integral part of the game is how well you "keep" or maintain your graveyard. The most important part of the graveyard is its rating. The [[church]] is located in the graveyard.

== Graveyard Rating ==
Graveyard rating is the main factor affecting the amount of money earned by donations in weekly sermons. It is therefore desirable to have a high {{Graveyard Rating}}.

There are four factors that affect quality: bushes, corpses, decor and graves.

===Bushes===
Bushes are present at the start of the game and do not currently regrow after being removed. Each bush has a -1 {{Graveyard Rating}} effect on rating.

===Corpses===
The quality of a buried {{item|corpse}} determines the maximum rating per grave. The number of {{Red Skull}}, {{Green Skull}} and {{White Skull}} in the corpse rating are the basis of the quality. No grave can have a higher {{Graveyard Rating}} rating than the number of {{White Skull}} on that corpse. Additionally, certain autopsy operations increase the base {{Graveyard Rating}} rating of a grave. See {{item|corpse}} for more info.

<sup>(Possible Bug Warning: If you exhume a corpse with 100% freshness from the right/east side of the graveyard, be wary of trying to improve it via [[autopsy]]. Corpses that spawned in the graveyard at the start of game may not acknowledge organs or parts added to them, effectively 'eating' the parts with no benefit. Parts can still be removed as normal. )</sup>

=== Decor ===
Decor includes things like lanterns, urns with ashes, flower beds, prayer stations, etc. Each piece of decor adds some amount of {{Graveyard Rating}}. The fence around the whole graveyard can be repaired for +10 {{Graveyard Rating}} and further upgraded for +20 {{Graveyard Rating}}.

===Graves===
[[Gravesite|Graves]] are an integral part of the game. Your first source of income in the game is {{Item|Burial certificate}}s. They are obtained by burying or cremating corpses, and can be sold to Horadric at [[Locations|The Dead Horse]] for {{Money|150}}. This price is fix.

Graves also have a positive or negative effect on the {{Graveyard Rating}} rating, based on the {{item|corpse}} quality and grave decorations. As the maximum benefit for tombstones is +7 {{Grave Decor}} and fences is +5 {{Grave Decor}}, no grave can have a rating higher than +12 {{Graveyard Rating}}, even if the {{item|corpse}} has more than 12 {{Skull|White}}. (With the [[Game of Crone]] DLC the maximum benefit for tombstones is increased to +9 {{Grave Decor}} and for fences to +7 {{Grave Decor}} resulting in a possible max. of 16{{Grave Decor}}. With the [[Better Save Soul]] DLC, more tombstones and fences are added allowing for the maximum of 26 {{Grave Decor}}.)

Grave sites have no effect on {{Graveyard Rating}} when placed or "planned" with the [[Work Stations|blueprint desk]] located in the graveyard. After being dug out for burial, the grave has a -2 {{Graveyard Rating}} effect on quality.

==== Grave Maintenance ====
Graves are in a state of disrepair in the beginning. This is made apparent during the tutorial when you are shown how to repair grave decorations. Grave decorations that have deteriorated will provide less {{Graveyard Rating}} which in turn will provide you with less income.

The Second time is after a cutscene with [[Yorick]]. This will occur once after you reach 100 {{Graveyard Rating}}. It will affect a couple of graves.

==== Tombstones ====
As noted in the corpses section, the maximum {{Graveyard Rating}} benefit of a grave cannot exceed the number of {{Skull|White}} of the corpse buried there.

== Graveyard Expansion ==
In the beginning, the west half of the graveyard is locked. The sign there tells you to speak to the [[Inquisitor]] about this. Once you have earned 20 {{Happiness}} with him, he hands you (or sells) a {{item|graveyard scroll}}. Return to the graveyard and use it there at the sign.

The west half is quite overgrown with a lot of shrubs and big trees. You'll need the [[Building (Tech_Tree)|"Woodcutter" technology]] to get rid of the trees. You won't get any negative {{Graveyard Rating}} from it, but you won't be able to build anything without clearing the area first.

== Royal Services ==
Once you are a [[Perks|preacher]], you gain access to the Royal services box located outside the front door of the church. It is through this box that you interact with the bureaucratic system behind the throne.

You upgrade citizen titles by spending money on the Crown. Each title costs you a certain amount of money, but grants you access to a number of items you'll need to advance certain [[quests]].

=== Exhumation Permission ===
{| class="wikitable"
!style = "width:17.5em;"|Item
!style = "width:5em;"|Cost
!Notes
|-
|{{Item|Exhumation permission}}
|{{Money|175}}
|required to dig up a buried body.
|}

Corpse exhumation is only needed when a badly autopsied corpse is negatively impacting your {{Graveyard Rating}}. To exhume a corpse, buy an {{Item|Exhumation permission}} from the church box. After you have removed the fence and the gravestone, you may select "exhume" and dig up the body.

'''Note:''' These cost {{Money|175}}, which is {{Money|25}} more than what you are paid for the {{Item|Burial certificate}}. You will earn much of the money back if you bury it again (after autopsy) or if you cremate it. So, overall it's a small loss for exhumation.
